title: CEE FX: Prolonged pressure from strong Dollar – ING
summary: Frantisek Taborsky at ING argues that the stronger US Dollar (USD) following the Federal Reserve (Fed) meeting is clearly negative for emerging markets, keeping Central and Eastern European (CEE) currencies under pressure.

title: US Dollar: Hawkish Fed supports Dollar against Euro - Danske Bank
summary: Danske Research Team explains that the Dollar strengthened after the Fed’s unanimous 25bp rate hike and hawkish risk assessment, which emphasized upside inflation risks.

title: US Dollar Index eases from late July highs as profit-taking kicks in amid sliding yields
summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, retreats slightly after hitting a fresh high since late July earlier this Thursday. The index, however, holds above the 100.00 psychological mark heading into the European session.
